name: Gabriela Camacho
office: City of Lynwood, Member of the City Council

items.text: Gabriela Camacho is the mayor of Lynwood and a City Council member, elected in 2022. She was city treasurer from 2015 to 2022, taught at Lynwood High School for 21 years, and is an assistant principal at Hosler Middle School.

sentences.text: Gabriela Camacho is the mayor of Lynwood and a City Council member, elected in 2022.
She was city treasurer from 2015 to 2022, taught at Lynwood High School for 21 years, and is an assistant principal at Hosler Middle School.

items.text: Her campaign says she wants a safer and stronger city. She highlighted a city partnership with the school district to support a safe start to the school year. She praised the $8 million renovation of the Lynwood Library as a place for the community to gather. The City Council approved a funding increase for sidewalk repairs and applied to join the Southeast Water Coalition. Camacho supported using a county grant to explore housing options along commercial corridors.
